{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or shows recent downward momentum.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoots following sharp price spikes by applying a 10-15% dampening factor.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast deviates >5% from 30-day moving average, adjust toward it.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices when sentiment is neutral or slightly positive.",
    "For long-term horizons (>7 days), reduce forecast volatility by smoothing with 5-day exponential moving average.",
    "When sentiment shows strong bullish momentum (e.g., >0.5), slightly increase forecast ceiling to avoid underestimation.",
    "If true outcome consistently underperforms forecast (e.g., 3 consecutive days), reduce next forecast by 2-3% to avoid overconfidence."
  ]
}
